title: When loneliness argues with reality
subtitle: For isolation that has started resisting the given day
description: These readings bring loneliness under Hukam so the ache can be held without turning the whole day into protest.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Belonging under grace lets loneliness be real without making it sovereign.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Receive the ache honestly, then ask what faithful action belongs to this actual day.

evidence.coreClaim: This path keeps loneliness from becoming rebellion against reality.
evidence.turn: Hukam gives the ache a place to stand without letting it rule the whole field.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name the loneliness, accept the day as given, and take one action of connection or remembrance.
